overall: The Committee had a proper purpose to enter executive session on June 18, but violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to name the nonunion personnel in its notice and motion.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Finance Committee entered executive session on June 18 without a proper purpose, citing collective bargaining under Purpose 3.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that it was appropriate for the Committee to enter executive session on June 18.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the June 18 notice and executive session motion failed to identify the nonunion personnel to be discussed.
allegations.key_passage: failing to specify, both in its posted meeting notice and in its motion to enter executive session, the name of the employee to be discussed.

remedy: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and we caution that similar future violations may be evidence of intent to violate the law.
